== Lead photograph (30 Oct 2026) ==
The lead is a Facebook photograph posted 2 August 2019. The Facebook photo viewer names Charles Lund. Identification: distinctive name plus Gold 43 on the Decipher Squadron roster (Coral Gables, FL) and the surviving Decipher profile. The Facebook group member card listed Edison State College and Richmond, Virginia; the profile listed Tampa, Florida.

The preserved copy is a screenshot of that Facebook photo viewer (name and date as they appeared). Identification stays on this Talk page. See [[:File:Charles Lund Facebook portrait.jpg]].
